purpose: A host-integrated idt with ic under uic starts integrating from ic.

oracle.derivation: VAMS-2023 4.5.4: ic is the integral at the start of the transient, and uic skips only the operating point that would solve it (ngspice MODEUIC gives a capacitor its IC the same way). V(out) = idt(V(in), 0.5) = 0.5 + t for V(in) = 1. Samples skip t = 0, where uic leaves every unsolved node at 0.
